exclusions.source_text: ECOG performance status 0 or 1 (Karnofsky ≥70%, see Appendix A)

exclusions.threshold: creatinine ≤ institutional ULN; GFR ≥50 mL/min/1.73 m2 (no lower than 30)

exclusions.source_text: total bilirubin ≤ institutional upper limit of normal (ULN)
To be eligible for this trial, participants should be class 2B or better.
Female participants: A female participant is eligible to participate if she is not pregnant (see Appendix B), not breastfeeding
Those with known brain metastases should be excluded from this clinical trial
Has a known additional malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the past 2 years.
Has a known history of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection.
A WOCBP who has a positive urine pregnancy test within 72 hours prior to study registration

Because there is an unknown but potential risk for adverse events in nursing infants secondary to treatment of the mother with pembrolizumab and chemotherapy, breastfeeding should be discontinued if the mother is treated on this protocol.
